newsitem.title: UK: MAM at record, Schroders up on strong FTSE.
newsitem.headline: MAM at record, Schroders up on strong FTSE.

text.p: Shares in Mercury Asset Management Plc set a record higher for a second day on Tuesday and Schroders Plc also rose sharply on the back of strength in the UK stock market, traders said.
Rising share values boost the value of the investment holdings of fund management groups as well as drawing fresh investment cash into equity investments.

MAM also stands to join the FTSE 100 index at next week's meeting of the index's membership committee. Its shares were up 32p at 12.35-1/2 stg by 1035 GMT, after earlier reaching a peak of 12.37 stg. Schroders was up 30p at 14.50 stg.
Earlier today the FTSE 100 index reached an intraday record of 4,094.4.
